summary: Virtuix Holdings Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement (Sticker Supplement No. 5) disclosing amendments to warrants held by Streeterville Capital LLC. The amendments reduce the exercise price of certain warrants to $2.50 per share (from a previously reduced $3.00) during a period ending August 27, 2026, with potential automatic one-month extensions. The filing also registers resale of 34,213,618 shares of Class A common stock by selling stockholders in connection with a direct listing on Nasdaq. This is an ordinary at-the-market or warrant amendment disclosure, not a special situation.
